notes:
{生姜|しょうが} is widely used in Japanese cuisine as a flavoring, condiment, and ingredient in traditional medicine.

KANJI:
Often written in hiragana (しょうが) in everyday contexts. The kanji {生姜|しょうが} is common in recipes and menus.

COMMON USES:
- {生姜|しょうが}⟦{焼|や}き→焼き：noentry⟧: ginger pork (one of the most popular home-cooked dishes)
- おろし{生姜|しょうが}: grated ginger (used as a condiment)
- ⟦{紅|べに}{生姜|しょうが}→紅生姜：28782_benishouga⟧: pickled red ginger (topping for ⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧, ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧)
- ⟦ガリ→ガリ：27408_gari⟧: pickled ginger (served with ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧)
- {生姜|しょうが}⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧: ginger tea (hot drink)

HEALTH:
In traditional Japanese and Chinese medicine, ginger is believed to warm the body, improve circulation, and aid digestion. {生姜|しょうが}⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ is a common home remedy for colds.
